content: Uburhu nu Usirha ru Utasarhonika
Uburhu nu Usirha aka azɛ̃rhã adɔsa udiku iteu Uamfiporhi nu Uafirhoniya, aba atsĩ uteu Utasarhonika, anangkɛ ubã ifɛn-Num abi Uyahuda uku uwe.
Ru nyaku Uburhu aka abayi, atsĩ ru ubã ifɛn-Num hã, inum iyiki iwiwosha itaar umbɔ aka anu irhisi itsɛng Arherhu-Num nggu umbɔ.
Unga anu isɔme umbɔ na adɛyiwe umbɔ idzidzɛrhe agɛ awu ufang Ukiristo aka ihwa uver na asoku udzak. Uburhu agɔr umbɔ agɛ, <<Uyesu ha umum iki inu indɛyiwa umbi unga awu Ukiristo.>>
Abɔɔ abi Uyahuda abemumbɔ arherhe Uburhu nu Usirha, nu arhɛrhɛ abi Uherhini abika agũ iwei Unum nu akatsɛrh akagɔng atomi itsi nggu umbɔ.
Bɔr abi Uyahuda abikase agũ unyɛ̃ɛ̃, umbɔ akɔng awɛ ugbau ra atsĩndĩ, umbɔ aka akɔng kishoo ahwita abi utepa. Akũ avɔm atsĩ ri iya Ujason abee Uburhu nu Usirha abee ikũna umbɔ adzeka ra anera.

Bɔr umbɔ aka asi inyãmbɔ umbɔ, umbɔ adarhu Ujason nu abika adɔsa abɔɔ akũna umbɔ azĩmbɔ ra asu abi ijee utepa, atsuyi ivum agɛ, <<Aner abɛrɛ abika asoyi amɛn ubɛn ananga ru upfung nggabɛ aka abambɔ nggimi.
Ujason ayɛi umbɔ akũ atsĩ ri iyanga. Kishoo akpɛ̃mbɔ idɔsi ikpem Ukaisar, anu igɔr agɛ uyɛrhe uwɔɔ, itsoknga igburh Uyesu.>>
Umbɔ aka agũ rimi, anera nu abi ijee utepa agũ avɔm akarhãrhã.
Mɔcɛ umbɔ atsu Ujason na anera abɔɔ afai uhwɛk na aneke umbɔ azĩmbɔ.
Uburhu nu Usirha ru Ubiriya
Utsuu uku ufin abika adɔsa adene Uburhu nu Usirha azĩmbɔ Ubiriya. Umbɔ aka azĩ atsĩ umɔ, umbɔ atsĩ ru ubã ifɛn-Num abi Uyahuda.

Abi Ubiriya awu ra amɛn akika agũ arherhe ha anangmbɔ abi Utasarhonika, ubinkutsu ayɛi arherhe ha aboka avaa avaa. Anu itsu asumbɔ ri itsɛng Arherhu-Num ubɛn unuma abee inyã ubinkpi Uburhu aka arherhe uwu idzidzɛrhe.
Abi Uyahuda arhɛrhɛ awe ru imangmang, nu abi Uherhini, akatsɛrh abika agɔng nu ikɛi akatsak.
Bɔr abi Uyahuda ru Utasarhonika aka agũ agɛ Uburhu adɛ̃ɛ̃ idzowe isarhe Arherhu-Num ru Ubiriya, umbɔ asok azĩmbɔ umɔ ikɛi. Umbɔ aka azĩ atsĩ, ahwita anera asoyiwe amɛnmbɔ.
Kanying kanying abika adɔsa akũ Uburhu azĩ ru ubang ukau azɛ̃ akagɔng, bɔr Usirha nu Utimoti aseimbɔ ru Ubiriya.
Abirabɛ aka azĩ adene Uburhu akũna unga azĩ atsĩmbɔ Uatina. Abvui aba akũ nggu itser Uburhu aka adene umbɔ ugɛ Usirha nu Utimoti aba akpo unga iki ifefetem.
Uburhu ru Uatina
Uburhu aka adɛ̃ɛ̃ adzɛu umbɔ ru Uatina, amɛnnga aghong akarhãrhã unga aka anyã utepa nggu agberhe arhɛrhɛ.
Nggee unga aka isaka arherha arherhe ru ubã ifɛn-Num nggu abi Uyahuda nu abi Uherhini abɔɔ abika agũ iwei Unum, ikɛi ubɛn unuma unga iki irherha arherhe nggu abirabɛ unga iki ikpo ra anang izɛɛ.

Rimi hã ikɛi abi ifɛrhkɔ itsoi umbɔ iki iyisa Uabikuriya nu Usitokiya anu irherha arherhe nggu unga. Abɔɔ arhusa agɛ, <<Uwɛrɛ uner ugbugbewa uwurɛ abee igɔr agɛ use?>> Abɔɔ agɛ, <<Awu uner uwuku udzowe isarhe anum abɔɔ abĩ akase.>> Ubinkutsu umbɔ arherhe rimi Uburhu anu idzowe Isarhe Iyiki Ize iyi Uyesu, nu isok ra akpe.
Mɔcɛ umbɔ akũna unga azĩmbɔ udzepurhe anang ikikɔngyɛ umbɔ aki iyisa Igũ Uarasa agɔr unga agɛ, <<Uba udɛyiwa umɛn imesa iyiki ifa iyɛ ungo uku unu imesuwe.
Ungo ukũ itsen arherhe ake atsĩ ra atomɛn, umɛn ibee ihwɛng agbena.>>
Kishoo aner Uatina nu atsen abika asei umɔ, anyangi ivangmbɔ asi ikorhumbɔ ubin bɔr anu irherhe na agosha abin aka afa.
Uburhu asok adɛ̃ɛ̃ ra asu ikikɔnga, na agɛ, <<Umbi aner Uatina! Umum inyã umbi awu abika abema agbeyi akarhãrhã nu afɛna kishoo.

Ubinkutsu ivangyɛ umum iki izɛ̃rhã imaa utepa umum inyãmum abinkɛ umbi iki idzowe igɔng nu ake, ikɛi umum inyãmum ubeu idɛm anummbi nggu itsɛng iki igɔr igɛ, <UZĨ RU UNUMWI UMBƆ AKA ASI IHWƐNGMBƆ.> Ubinkpi umbi aka asi ihwɛngmbi na adzowe igɔng ru ukpɔ, awu unga umum iki inu idɛyiwa umbi.
<<Unumwi aka amunu upfung nu kishoo abinkɛ aka awu umɔ awu Uteijee afã nu abĩ na asi iseisa ra aya-Numkɛ anera iki idzin.
Unga asi ibeenga anera ayike unga, asi ibeenga ubin, ubinkutsu, awu unga adzowe anera kishoo urhɛ nu uwoyi nu abina kishoo.
Awu ru unera unying unga aka amunu idũa kishoo, agɛ umbɔ asei ra ananga kishoo ru upfung, unga angwɛ̃ ivangyɛ umbɔ aka isei atsĩ nu inangyɛ umbɔ aka isei.
Unum akorhe rimi ngge itsú anera ibeea unga, na awuri ima abãrhã azĩmbɔ ru unga, na awuri ikpombɔ unga. Idzidzɛrhe, asi idera nggu ubɛn unera ru umɛn.
<Ubinkutsu, iwu ru unga umɛn iki iwe ru urhɛ, ni izɛ̃rhã, ni ibɛk.> Ru nyaka abika atsɛng ambommbi abɔɔ aki igɔr agɛ, <Umɛn iwu unangnga.>
<<Ngge iki iwe ugɛ umɛn iwu unang Unum, asi imɛ̃ɛ̃ umɛn ikaifɛrhkɔ ugɛ Unum awu ru uzirhzĩ uzinarhi use uazurhfa use atarh, ubinkpi unera iki ikorhe ri itsoinga.
Ri iyi isha Unum asi ibeenga idzowe anera uver ihwihwɛng iki ishingge ru umbɔ, bɔr icɛrɛ unga atsu anera kishoo ubɛn ananga umbɔ adzipa.

Ubinkutsu unga aka angwɛ̃ɛ̃ unumkpi unga aka iba atsu uvau iyi idzidzɛrhe ru upfunga ru ubok uwɔɔ unga aka asɛng. Unga aka adɛyiwa arherhe ha iwuri iwe rimi ra anera kishoo ri isoyiwe uner ha ra akpe.>>
Ivangyɛ umbɔ aka agũ arherhe isisok ra akpe, abɔɔ acata, bɔr abɔɔ agɛ, <<Umɛn ibee ibvui igũ ubinkpi ungo uku irherhe ra arherha akɛrɛ.>>
Awu umɔ Uburhu aka abɔre umbɔ.
Bɔr abɔɔ ukunjiir agbopa nggu Uburhu awe abi imangmang. Ru umbɔ ha awu Udiyonisiyu, uner itser ru udzepurhe, nu utsɛrh uwɔɔ itsoka igburh Udamari, na abɔɔ nggu umbɔ.
